visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair and bangs wearing a cream-colored oversized sweater with a bulldog graphic and red text exits a dark interior doorway. Two men in black suits and blue shirts block her path. One man wears sunglasses and has light brown hair. The setting is a narrow urban alleyway with a staircase in the background. (2) The man in sunglasses holds up a smartphone displaying a vertical video of a person lying on the ground in an alleyway, surrounded by small white objects. The lighting is flat but natural. (3) A brief cutaway shows a man with glasses and a grey hoodie lying prone on a white table, grimacing with his mouth open in pain. He is in a brightly lit indoor room with blue walls. (4) Back in the alley, the man in sunglasses continues to show the phone to the woman, who looks concerned and confused. She adjusts the collar of her sweater with her right hand. (5) The woman pushes between the two men, making physical contact with their suits, and runs toward the camera. The man in sunglasses gestures with his hand and speaks to the other man. (6) The woman is seen running on a paved street at dusk. A silver car pulls up, and she opens the door and gets into the passenger seat. The background shows city buildings and a highway overpass under a grey sky. (7) Inside the car, the woman in the sweater talks to a female driver with long brown hair. The lighting is dim and cool-toned. (8) The two men from earlier are shown running down a street decorated with red and yellow Chinese lanterns hanging overhead. The man in sunglasses looks around while running. (9) Close-up shots alternate between the woman in the sweater and the female driver as they converse inside the moving car. (10) The video ends with a black screen containing white Chinese and English text credits, listing names and social media handles.
